scope: 67 graph-theoretic transitive flags (all 34 capabilities, 110 edges), not all direct edges
criteria: Direct consumer obligation, material provider-owned semantic input, intermediate accepted contract sufficiency. Core mirroring/structural transitivity NOT a decision criterion.

findings.direct_semantic_assessment: Model Context Strategy uses product-level Target and learner obligations; Domain Strategy only classifies subdomains.
findings.mediation_counterfactual: The strategic subdomain contract does not supply observable Product requirements.

findings.direct_semantic_assessment: Relation classifier defines reusable Subject Knowledge predicates; its catalog does not name a distinct learner-facing product rule.
findings.mediation_counterfactual: Find a product requirement materially changing classification, not already mediated by Model Context Strategy.

findings.direct_semantic_assessment: Knowledge Model defines Subject Knowledge identity and cross-context limits; relation classifier owns only predicate vocabulary.
findings.mediation_counterfactual: Predicate-vocabulary contract cannot replace model-context ownership.

findings.direct_semantic_assessment: Knowledge Model explicitly interprets the product requirement for overview, scope and depth.
findings.mediation_counterfactual: Model Context Strategy does not own those product-visible obligations.

findings.direct_semantic_assessment: Learning Design spans Capability, Performance and Preparation Direction contexts outside Subject Knowledge.
findings.mediation_counterfactual: Knowledge Model does not export applicability of the other model languages.

findings.direct_semantic_assessment: Learning Design owns learning/practice support and target requirements responding directly to product intent.
findings.mediation_counterfactual: Knowledge/context strategy alone does not supply product-facing support commitments.

findings.direct_semantic_assessment: Learner Model owns observed Performance, evidence inference and learner-state semantics.
findings.mediation_counterfactual: Knowledge Model does not supply ownership of learner evidence/state.

findings.direct_semantic_assessment: Learner Model needs direct product obligations for explainability, state and target-relative assessment.
findings.mediation_counterfactual: Knowledge/context contracts do not replace accepted product-visible evidence duties.
